text: I think you'll really enjoy this Mexican-Style Rice recipe, given your fondness for rice and chicken. Since you're looking to reduce sugar intake, this dish is a great option as it contains only 4g of sugar per serving. Additionally, the recipe is quick to prepare, fitting within your 45-minute time frame. The use of vegetable or chicken stock, depending on your preference, adds flavor without introducing dairy, making it a suitable option for your dietary needs.
